name: repocoach-fe
description: AI project deep-dive interview coach for React and Next.js interns.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace apps/web" "npm run start:dev --workspace apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/api
scripts.test:api: npm run build --workspace apps/api && node --test apps/api/test/*.test.cjs
